edit.title: Shape the inspection window
edit.subtitle: Build a non-destructive edit recipe, preview it safely, and commit a derived analysis-ready output.
edit.previewEmptyTitle: Edit preview is waiting for a project source
edit.previewEmptyBody: Return to the source stage, capture a real file into the active project, then come back to shape the derived output.
edit.workspaceHint: The working surface always shows the source, the latest preview, or the active derived output.

edit.modeSubtitle: Switch between guardrailed presets and deeper direct controls.
edit.presetSubtitle: Starter recipes keep inexperienced operators on a safe path.
edit.commonSubtitle: These fields persist across preview and derived renders.
edit.videoSubtitle: Trim, resize, and focus the analysis cut without touching the original.
edit.audioSubtitle: Prepare speech or ambience with a safe normalization chain.
edit.imageSubtitle: Crop, rotate, and tune still frames for OCR or evidence review.
edit.actionsSubtitle: Generate a safe preview first, then publish a project-owned derived output.
edit.outputsSubtitle: Each applied render is stored under the project and can be handed to later stages.
edit.outputsEmpty: No derived outputs yet. Generate one after previewing the recipe.
edit.ffmpegMissing: FFmpeg is required for the edit stage. Install or update it from settings.

profile.title: Shape the analysis profile
profile.subtitle: Choose the target asset, inspection depth, and AI-assisted side checks before the heavy analysis run.
profile.targetSubtitle: Decide whether the profile reads the original source or the active derived output.
profile.targetEmptyBody: Prepare a source or select a derived output to unlock the profile surface.
profile.modeSubtitle: Start with guided presets or open the full lane console.
profile.presetSubtitle: Each preset mixes authenticity, continuity, and transcript-aware checks in a different way.
profile.advancedSubtitle: Tune the probe depth, sensitivity, lane mix, and optional transcript model.

laneMeta.incompatible: Not available for the current media type.
laneMeta.speechToolMissing: Install Whisper.cpp to unlock transcript-aware speech sampling.
laneMeta.speechModelMissing: Install a transcript model to unlock the deeper speech lane.

profile.artifactControlsSubtitle: Choose which lightweight evidence files the preflight should generate.
profile.signalsSubtitle: These are the strongest indicators surfaced by the current lightweight pass.
profile.signalsEmpty: No preflight findings yet. Run the preflight to surface signals.
profile.artifactsSubtitle: Each run can drop metadata, frame strips, and audio traces into the project.
profile.preflightSubtitle: Run a lightweight screening pass before the full process stage.
profile.sourceRequired: Prepare a source before building the profile.
profile.modelSubtitle: Optional Whisper.cpp models help the room sample speech continuity and overdub clues.
profile.modelUnavailable: Install the room-local Whisper.cpp binary first to manage transcript models on this platform.

metadata-lineage.title: Metadata lineage
metadata-lineage.summary: Check whether container timing, file lineage, and obvious metadata seams feel coherent.

visual-tamper.title: Visual tamper
visual-tamper.summary: Look for freezes, dark gaps, and frame-window instability that often marks visual edits.

audio-tamper.title: Audio tamper
audio-tamper.summary: Scan silence, loudness drift, and spectral continuity for cleanup or splice fingerprints.

speech-overlay.title: Speech overlay
speech-overlay.summary: Use transcript-aware sampling to catch overdubs, replaced phrases, and dialogue mismatch.

synthetic-suspicion.title: Synthetic suspicion
synthetic-suspicion.summary: Blend the strongest cross-lane cues into a single suspicion score for the next stage.

quick-authenticity.title: Quick authenticity
quick-authenticity.summary: Fast source-first sweep for obvious video seams and metadata drift.

dialogue-overdub.title: Dialogue overdub
dialogue-overdub.summary: Bias the run toward speech continuity, silence cuts, and overdub clues.

balanced-forensic.title: Balanced forensic
balanced-forensic.summary: Use the active derived output and enable every supported lane for a denser pass.

overdub-check.title: Overdub check
overdub-check.summary: Short audio-first pass tuned for dialogue replacement and splice traces.

continuity-pass.title: Continuity pass
continuity-pass.summary: Balanced waveform and transcript-aware sweep for continuity issues.

quick-lineage.title: Quick lineage
quick-lineage.summary: Fast metadata and frame-surface check for origin and sharing clues.

safe-share-audit.title: Safe share audit
safe-share-audit.summary: Derived-output profile that focuses on visual tamper and exposure breadcrumbs.

en.title: Tiny English
en.summary: Smallest transcript model. Fastest option for a lightweight speech sanity check.

en.title: Base English
en.summary: Heavier transcript model with better recall for difficult dialogue and room tone.

process.title: Follow the staged process
process.subtitle: Monitor the dummy pipeline as the room advances through each analysis segment.
process.summaryHintActive: The dummy process keeps moving while this stage stays open.
process.summaryHintDone: The staged process reached its final checkpoint and can roll into the report view.

report.title: Review the staged handoff
report.subtitle: This final pane reflects the latest profile results without pretending the full process stage has already run.
report.stagedHint: This view mirrors the current profile run. Final analysis and a true verdict still belong to later stages.
report.emptyFindings: No profile signals are ready yet.
report.emptyBody: Run a profile preflight first, then this staged handoff view will surface its strongest findings.
